auto.label: Automatic check
auto.staffNote: Rules, not a person and not AI. Findings point at the student's text; nothing is rewritten. Fact checks compare with the profile.
auto.studentNote: An automatic check that follows rules, not a person. It points out sentences to check and never changes or writes your text.

finding.UNDER_LENGTH: {{count}} of {{limit}} words. There is room for more detail.
finding.UNDER_CHAR_LENGTH: {{count}} of {{limit}} characters. There is room for more detail.
finding.WRONG_LANGUAGE: The university asks for this text in another language ({{required}}).
finding.REPEATED_SENTENCE: This sentence appears more than once.
finding.REPEATED_OPENER: {{count}} sentences start the same way. Try varying how sentences begin.
finding.GENERIC_PHRASE: Many applicants use this phrase. A concrete detail from your own experience says more.
finding.NOT_SPECIFIC: The text never mentions {{university}} or the program. As written, it could be sent to any university.
finding.OVERCLAIM: An absolute claim. Readers trust evidence more than superlatives.
finding.LONG_SENTENCE: A {{words}}-word sentence. Consider splitting it so it is easier to follow.
finding.PARAGRAPHS: Break the text into paragraphs so the reader can follow the argument.
finding.OTHER_UNIVERSITY: Mentions {{name}}, but this text is for {{target}}. Check that it wasn't copied from another application.
finding.NAME_MISSPELLED: Did you mean “{{expected}}” instead of “{{found}}”? Names must be exactly right.
finding.SIMILAR_TEXT: Passages ({{passages}}) are identical to another document in Hangyul. Talk to the student before approving, and never share the other text.
finding.FACT_GRAD_YEAR_expected: Your profile says expected graduation {{profile_year}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_GRAD_YEAR_graduated: Your profile says you graduated in {{profile_year}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_DEGREE: Your profile lists {{level}} as your highest education. Please check.
finding.FACT_GPA: Your profile says GPA {{profile_gpa}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_TOPIK: Your profile says TOPIK {{profile}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_TOPIK_none: Your profile has no TOPIK result yet. Please check, or add it to your profile.
finding.FACT_IELTS: Your profile says IELTS {{profile}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_IELTS_none: Your profile has no IELTS result yet. Please check, or add it to your profile.
finding.FACT_NATIONALITY: This mentions {{claimCountry}}; your profile says {{profileCountry}}. Please check.
finding.FACT_SCHOOL: Your profile lists {{profile}}. Please check the school name.
finding.FACT_AGE: Your date of birth makes you {{profile_age}}. Please check.
finding.OTHER_PROGRAM: Names the {{found}} program, but this application is for {{expected}}. Check that the paragraph wasn't reused.
finding.CROSS_APP_CONFLICT: {{topicLabel}}: this text says {{claim}}, your {{otherLabel}} says {{other}}. Use the same fact everywhere.
finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one: Automatic check: {{count}} part of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_other: Automatic check: {{count}} parts of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm

gate.intro: Every point must be clear before final approval. Points come from the rubric, the automatic checks and open comments. There is no score.

reason.PROMPT_UNKNOWN: The university's question is not attached yet
reason.NOT_ASSESSED: Not rated in the rubric yet
reason.NO_LIMIT: No limit known for this question
reason.FACT_GRAD_YEAR: Graduation year differs from the profile
reason.FACT_DEGREE: Degree level differs from the profile
reason.FACT_TOPIK: TOPIK level differs from the profile
reason.FACT_SCHOOL: School name differs from the profile
reason.NAME_MISSPELLED: A university or program name is misspelled
reason.CROSS_APP_CONFLICT: A fact differs from the student's other essays
reason.OPEN_COMMENTS_one: {{count}} comment to the student still open
reason.OPEN_COMMENTS_other: {{count}} comments to the student still open
reason.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one: Automatic check: {{count}} part of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
reason.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_other: Automatic check: {{count}} parts of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm

gate.approveExplain: Version {{version}} becomes the version the application uses. The student can still reopen it; the application keeps this version until a new one is approved.
gate.overrideHint: At least 10 characters. Saved with the list of open blockers in the audit log.
gate.needsManager: Only a manager can approve while a blocker is open. Resolve the blockers or ask your manager.
gate.approvedToast: Approved. The application now uses this version

dim.GENERIC: Not generic (couldn't be sent to any university)

dimHelp.ANSWERS_PROMPT: Every part of the university's question is answered.
dimHelp.PROGRAM_CONNECTION: Names what in this program fits the student's background, not Korea in general.
dimHelp.FUTURE_PLAN: What they will study and do after graduating, concretely.
dimHelp.EVIDENCE: Claims are shown with examples from their own experience.
dimHelp.VOICE: Reads like the student's own voice and level of English or Korean.
dimHelp.TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE: Check the automatic similarity finding before rating.

rubric.intro: Rate each point on the current version. Ratings are for the team; the student sees the quality gate in final review.
rubric.notePh: What exactly needs work? (visible to the team)

prompt.title: University question

status.SAMPLE: Not yet checked against the source

prompt.studentCopy: Pasted by the student. Not yet checked against the official guide.
prompt.unknownStaff: We don't have this university's exact question yet. Attach it (or enter it with its source) so the checks and the gate use the right question.
prompt.noneKnown: No known version for this university and essay type yet. Enter it.
prompt.textLabel: The question, exactly as the university writes it
prompt.textHint: Copy it word for word. It is saved as a new version for this intake.
prompt.enteredNote: Saved as “Entered by a reviewer” for {{intake}} and used for this essay. Hangyul marks it checked once compared with the source.
prompt.saved: Question attached. Automatic checks ran again
prompt.studentCopyStudent: You pasted this question. Your counselor will confirm it.
prompt.unknownStudent: We don't have this university's exact question yet. Your counselor will confirm it. You can start writing about your motivation, background and plans.
prompt.unconfirmedStudent: Not yet checked against the university's official wording. Your counselor will confirm the actual question.

sl.LATE: Taking longer than expected. {{name}} is working on it.
sl.LATE_FLAGGED: Taking longer than expected. We've told the {{org}} manager. You don't need to do anything.
sl.LATE_FLAGGED_HANGYUL: Taking longer than expected. We've told the Hangyul team. You don't need to do anything.

student.question: The university's question
student.factsSub: They say something different from your profile. Only you can decide which is right. Fix the sentence or update your profile.
student.checked: Checked. Nothing in your text was changed
student.noFindings: Nothing to point out right now.
student.gateSub: What your reviewer confirms before this becomes the version your application uses.
student.stillApproved: Your application still uses version {{version}} (approved). Your changes need a new approval before they replace it.
student.pastePrompt: The university's question (if you have it)
student.pastePromptHint: Paste it exactly. Your counselor confirms it.

queue.sub: Essays waiting for a person. Oldest promise first.

empty.first: No essays waiting for a first review
empty.due48: Nothing due in the next 48 hours

queue.emptyText: New submissions appear here with their expected review time.
queue.keys: j / k move · Enter opens · in an essay: n next essay, c comment, 1–5 panels

ws.keys: Select text to comment · c comment · n next essay · 1 comments · 2 checks · 3 rubric · 4 gate · 5 versions
ws.studentTextLabel: Student text, read-only. Suggest changes through comments; the student decides.
ws.audienceTeam: Only your team sees this, never the student
ws.suggestionHint: A wording suggestion on the selected text. The student accepts or ignores it. Never invent facts or experiences.
ws.internalBanner: Internal note, not visible to the student
ws.finalHint: Final review starts the final-check clock. The student sees the quality gate.

checks.ran: Automatic checks ran on the current version
checks.dismissed: Finding dismissed. The note is saved

match.title: Reassign reviewer
match.sub: Ranked by language, degree, field, university, country, workload and review times. The reason is recorded.

insights.title: Writing insights
insights.sub: Internal. Shows how fast essays are reviewed and how patterns relate to outcomes. It is not a prediction.
insights.turnaroundDef: Hours from the student's submission to the reviewer's response, per review round.
insights.roundsDef: Submissions before approval, for essays approved in the period.
insights.breachesFoot: reviews not answered by their expected time
insights.breachesDef: A review round not answered by its expected time (first 48 h, revision 48 h, final 24 h unless your policy differs).
insights.patternsSub: Approved essays next to the application decision. n per group; groups under 5 are withheld; no causal claims.
insights.none: No decided applications with an approved essay yet.
insights.population: Includes essays with an approved version whose application received a decision.
insights.caveat: These are counts, not rates of success, and they do not show that one way of reviewing causes a result.

v6.unverified: Question not yet verified against the official guide.
v6.studentPasted: Pasted by the student. Not yet checked against the official guide.
v6.commentPh: What should the student think about here? Ask, don't rewrite.
v6.suggestHint: Optional. The student accepts or declines it. Only reword what they wrote. Never add facts or experiences.
v6.selectHint: Select a passage in the text to comment on it (C).
v6.noFindings: No open findings on this version.
v6.autoNote: Automatic checks are rules, not a person. They point at the student's sentences and never change the text; your judgement decides.
v6.rubricIntro: Rate the current version. Ratings are for the team; there is no total. Point out what to improve, but never write the student's content for them.

dim.FACTUAL_CONSISTENCY: Facts match the profile and other essays

dimAsk.ANSWERS_PROMPT: Is every part of the university's question answered?
dimAsk.GENERIC: Could this text only have been written for this program, or for any program?
dimAsk.VOICE: Does it sound like this student, at their level, about their own experiences?
dimAsk.STRUCTURE: Is there a clear beginning, development and end, one idea per paragraph?
dimAsk.LOGIC: Does each step follow from the last; are claims connected to reasons?
dimAsk.MOTIVATION: Why this university? Are the reasons specific to it?
dimAsk.PROGRAM_CONNECTION: Does their background lead to this major?
dimAsk.FUTURE_PLAN: What will they study and do after graduating, concretely?
dimAsk.EVIDENCE: Are claims shown with examples from their own life?
dimAsk.CLARITY: Can a busy admissions reader follow every sentence the first time?
dimAsk.NAMES_CORRECT: Every university and program name exactly right?
dimAsk.FACTUAL_CONSISTENCY: Grades, years and scores match the profile and the student's other essays?
